title: BC Friday Tips #54 Report Explorer
summary: The Report Explorer is a discovery tool in Business Central that helps users browse and find available reports from the Role Center or via Tell Me. It lets you locate reports by name or uncover useful ones you might not have known existed.
key_points: Access Report Explorer from Role Center via All Reports or through Tell Me with Exploring Reports
Helps find reports when you don't know their exact names
Enables discovery of reports you may have overlooked
Useful tool for consultants to learn about available reporting capabilities

quotes.text: The Report Explorer helps you browse all available reports and discover the one you need.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core purpose of the Report Explorer feature

quotes.text: Find reports even when you don't know their names.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a key benefit for users searching for reports without knowing exact names
